# rintup_locations (Data Source)

Probe locations, ordered by code. Their fixed egress addresses can be allow-listed in firewalls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rintup_locations" "all" {}

# Allow-list RintUp probes in a firewall.
output "rintup_probe_ipv4" {
  value = flatten(data.rintup_locations.all.locations[*].ipv4)
}

# Check from every location.
resource "rintup_monitor" "everywhere" {
  type      = "http"
  locations = data.rintup_locations.all.codes
  http      = { url = "https://www.example.com" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `codes` (List of String) All location codes.
- `locations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Location code, used in `rintup_monitor.locations`.
- `country` (String) Country code.
- `ipv4` (List of String) Fixed IPv4 egress addresses.
- `ipv6` (List of String) Fixed IPv6 egress addresses.
- `name` (String) City / region name.
- `online` (Boolean) The probe reported recently.
